reviewer_feedback: Updated the TNT Bow to spawn 100 TNT in batches of 5 with a 1-tick delay between batches to improve performance.
usage_instructions: Use /give-tnt-bow to receive the special TNT Bow.

traces.intent_summary: Modify the TNT bow to spawn 100 TNT with a 1-tick delay interval every 5 TNT spawned.

traces.rationale: I implemented a counter variable {_count} inside the loop. Every time 5 TNT are spawned, the script resets the counter and executes a 'wait 1 tick' command to introduce the requested delay while maintaining the total count of 100 TNT.
